narr: Heavy rainfall repeatedly moved across portions of Northwestern Alabama, producing nuisance flooding, as well as a few instances of flash flooding (water flooding a basement) just West of Underwood-Petersville. Upwards of three inches of rain fell between 10pm and Midnight in this area.
ev: Side creeks overflowing, along with nearby cropland. A yard was covered with water and a basement was flooded. Depth of water unknown.
lsr: SIDE CREEKS OVERFLOWING. NEARBY CROPLAND AND YARD ALSO COVERED BY WATER. A BASEMENT WAS REPORTED FLOODED AS WELL.
